chamada: Write on the theme of the week, review other people's essays using the 5 ENEM competencies and get your own reviews back. **Nobody knows whose essay it is, or who reviewed it.**
entrar: Join Alumia to take part in the essay circle.

tema.semTema: The coordination has not posted this week's theme yet. Come back soon.
tema.semTemaCoord: This week has no theme yet. Post one in the Themes tab.

troca.afastada: You are out of the circle until {data}, because of a review the mediation team judged abusive.

itens.texto: Reviewers get only the text. Writers get only the review sheet. No name, no codename, on either side.
Each essay is read by two people, using the 5 ENEM competencies, with a score from 0 to 200 and a comment for each one.
Your reviews arrive once you have reviewed two essays from the same circle. If the circle is full when you ask, your exchange counts as done.
The essay and its reviews are permanently deleted 30 days after they are returned. Once returned, the database keeps no record of who read what.
A review that insults goes to mediation. If it is abusive, it leaves your screen, your essay gets another review and whoever wrote it is taken out of the circle, without anyone learning who they are.

escrever.dica: Write your argumentative essay right here. Do not sign it or write your name: reviews are blind.
escrever.entregue: Handed in. Your essay is in the circle.
escrever.jaEntregou: You have already handed in this week's essay. Follow it in Feedback.
escrever.rascunho: The draft stays only on this device until you hand it in.

corrigir.chamada: Ask for an essay from the circle. You have 72 hours to send back the review sheet; if you can't, let it go and it returns to the circle.
corrigir.pedir: Ask for an essay to read
corrigir.nenhuma: No essays are waiting for review right now. Come back later.
corrigir.dispensada: The circle is full: no essays are waiting for review. Your exchange for this circle counts as done.
corrigir.duasAbertas: You already have two open reviews. Finish one before asking for another.
corrigir.jaLendo: You're already reading one. You can take one more, up to two open.
corrigir.comentarioDica: What worked and what to improve, in at least 20 characters.
corrigir.falta: Competency {n} is missing its score or comment.
corrigir.enviada: Review sent. Thank you for reading carefully.
corrigir.cega: You don't know whose text this is, and the writer will never know it was you.

competencias.resumo: Command of the formal written standard of Portuguese.
Understand the prompt and develop the theme in an argumentative essay, drawing on knowledge from several fields.
Select, relate, organize and interpret information, facts and opinions to defend a point of view.
Use the linguistic devices that build the argument (cohesion).
Propose an intervention for the problem, respecting human rights.

devolutivas.vazio: You have not handed in any essay yet.
devolutivas.faltaCorrigir: Review {n} more to receive your reviews.
devolutivas.faltaUma: Review 1 more to receive your reviews.
devolutivas.esperandoLeituras: You have done your part of the exchange. Your reviews arrive together, once they are ready.
devolutivas.encerrada: The circle closed and this essay was not returned. It will be deleted on {data}.
devolutivas.devolvida: Returned on {data}. Everything is deleted on {apagar}.
devolutivas.verTexto: See the text you handed in
devolutivas.apagarConfirma: Permanently delete this essay and its reviews?
devolutivas.removida: The mediation team removed this review. Your essay went back to the circle for a new review.
devolutivas.denunciaMotivo: What is abusive about this review?
devolutivas.denunciaDica: It goes to mediation, which reads the review without knowing whose it is. At least 10 characters.
devolutivas.denunciaAberta: Reported. The mediation team will look at it.
devolutivas.denunciaNaoAbusiva: The mediation team read it and found no abuse in this review.
devolutivas.denunciaAbusiva: The mediation team judged this review abusive.

mediacao.chamada: Reviews reported by the people who received them. You don't see who wrote the essay or who reviewed it. Abusive: the review is removed, the essay gets another review and whoever wrote it is out of the circle for 8 weeks, without the name appearing to anyone.
mediacao.pendente: Judged abusive. The suspension is still pending.
mediacao.feito: Done. Whoever wrote it is out of the circle for 8 weeks; the name does not appear here.
mediacao.semLacre: The review was removed. This review could not be linked to anyone, so nobody was suspended.

temas.chamada: One theme per week, Monday to Sunday. A theme can only change while nobody has handed in an essay on it.
temas.fechado: This week already has essays: the theme can no longer change.

erros.banco_desatualizado: The essay circle is not switched on on this server yet.
